svg.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: SPI Mode 0 frame, captured from simulation
OP_RD_ID frame. MOSI: 0x81 0x00 0x00 0x00 0x00. MISO: 0x00 0x4D 0x50 0x01 0x02. Core clock 10 ns, 4 core cycles per SPI half period, so f_spi = f_core/8.
controller samples MISO and the chip samples MOSI on every rising edge
The chip loads its outgoing byte on the first falling edge of each byte, which gives the command router half an SPI period to fetch the answer.
MISO reads 0x00 during the opcode byte because no opcode has been decoded yet, then carries the answer to the byte before it: standard one byte command latency.
Drawn by tools/svg_spi_timing.py from results/trace/spi_frame.json, captured by tb/test_spi_protocol.py::test_capture_timing_trace.
